goal: Apply the proven Neuro API and action/context architecture to CMRE Dead of Night while preserving simulator-first transport boundaries.
acceptance: Neuro startup, context, action registration, action result, and reconnect contracts are typed and locally testable
Simulator action/context loop works without an SC2 executable or Bank dependency
Dead of Night mission state is projected without exposing hidden simulator state
Campaign, mission, and runtime state are separated and versioned
The same upper-layer contract can later map to simulator, SC2 API, Bank, and input transports
Real-SC2 completion is claimed only with launcher and GameLogs runtime evidence
